$comment: ARC-87 minimum balance requirement vectors. toMBR(object) = MIN_BALANCE + sum over every box of (PER_BOX + PER_UNIT * (utf8Bytes(key) + utf8Bytes(value))). Values are the leaf serialised with String(value) and encoded as UTF-8 (numbers become their decimal text, null becomes 'null'). Keys are the full box keys PREFIX + path, measured in UTF-8 bytes. ARC-87 does not define how key names longer than MAX_KEY_SIZE are stored (templatization is left to a future specification), so a key longer than MAX_KEY_SIZE or a value longer than MAX_BOX_SIZE MUST throw MaxSizeError rather than being rewritten. `errors` lists `{ [key]: 'a'.repeat(valueLength) }` objects with the byte length of the full key and the expected error (null when accepted). `mbr` is expressed in microAlgos as a decimal string so bigint consumers do not lose precision.

cases.name: empty object only costs the minimum balance
spec: Blob/File table (number serialised as text)
escaped segments are charged at their escaped length
key of exactly 64 bytes is charged in full
unicode key is charged in bytes (31 chars, 64 bytes)

errors.$comment: The test builds { [key]: 'a'.repeat(valueLength) } before calling toMBR; keyBytes is utf8Bytes(PREFIX + key).
errors.name: value of MAX_BOX_SIZE bytes is accepted
value larger than MAX_BOX_SIZE throws MaxSizeError
key of exactly MAX_KEY_SIZE bytes is accepted
key one byte over MAX_KEY_SIZE throws MaxSizeError
spec: Templatization example key is rejected (templating is out of scope)
errors.key: this is a really long key that for some reason is extra long even though it probably doesn't need to be this long but idk maybe someone has a key this long

errors.name: unicode key over the limit in bytes (32 chars, 66 bytes) throws MaxSizeError
